paired_H20.historical_v2_reproduction: not claimed; this bridge isolates patience within the uniform Nov3 label cohort

issues.issue: Repeated static NameDFilter preparation caused an operational interruption before fits.
issues.lesson: Preserve original instrument spans and static predicate; verify completed years exactly before continuing optimized preparation.

issues.issue: Unified Nov3 labels changed 106 H20 ranked labels, so confirmed H20 models could not be reused as identical inputs.
issues.lesson: Re-fit the control and validate paired efficacy before the grid. Identical objective histories/selected rounds do not imply identical full predictions; small input differences do not uniquely establish the historical performance-gap cause.

issues.issue: Patience50 did not remove all short selections, tie-priority sensitivity, or cap censoring across H.
issues.lesson: Freeze diagnostics and interpretation limits in advance. Check the whole score trajectory, including early tied alternatives; a tie-free selected round alone does not establish robustness. Do not change patience by H or delete seeds after seeing results.

issues.issue: Exact shared-cache blocks had no durable retention reference.
issues.lesson: Retained research inputs need explicit persistent references distinct from active-process leases; do not rely only on recency-based cache retention.

issues.issue: Registration adapter used the parent experiment itself as an internal H20 comparison ref; existing schema rejects self-reference.
issues.lesson: Validate actual metadata against the existing archive schema before recording result/registration. Give all seven internal arms distinct refs; resume after a recorded result without duplicating it. No formal module, scientific attempt or fit was added.

issues.issue: Browser URL policy rejected file:// report preview.
issues.lesson: Do not bypass the blocked browser action or claim full browser QA. Local scientific plots were visually inspected; HTML source numbers, structure and links were verified.

minor_operational_errors: One audit-writer command had a syntax error before any file was written; corrected without research changes.
One read-only monitor invocation used a mistyped interpreter path and exited127; corrected immediately, training unaffected.
interpretation: Frozen hypothesis booleans describe the observed metric pattern and are not rewritten. Short selections, boundary ties, reverse-priority sensitivity or round-cap censoring are reported separately; where present, they limit attribution of performance differences to the training horizon itself. H20 paired patience efficacy is not a universal proof that early-stop problems were removed for every H.
limitations: Historical selection window also used for early stopping; not independent out of sample.
F has only 136 days in seven months of 2024; no cross-year confirmation.
Each H uses its own valid-label mask under the legacy H40-base protocol; no seven-H common-sample intersection.
Monotonicity and endpoint winners are reported separately; no H-specific patience tuning or promotion.
Historical v2 training reproduction root cause remains unresolved; 106 changed H20 labels do not establish causality.
early_stopping_recommendation: Patience50 is supported by paired H20 results in this historical window, not a universal fix. A separate future early-stop study should first specify deterministic/tie-robust head handling and compare smoother selection objectives under a frozen validation design. No such rule is changed or trial added here.
next_scope: The prespecified seven-H grid and fixed-s5 verification are exhausted. No additional H, patience, seeds, weights, strategy tuning, baseline change or production change.
cleanup: Written before cleanup; final result/mlruns/temp disposition is recorded separately in docs/harness-cleanup.json. This review does not claim cleanup already happened.
